property.name: baseColor
property.shortdesc: The color that the tint is based on.

property.name: colorValue
property.shortdesc: The ink values that create the color, specified as a percentage for each ink. Note: The number of values required and the range depends on the color space. For RGB, specify three values, with each value in the range 0 to 255; for CMYK, specify four values representing C, M, Y, and K, with each value in the range 0 to 100; for LAB, specify three values representing L (Range: 0 to 100), A (Range: -128 to 127), and B (Range: -128 to 127); for mixed ink, specify values for each ink in the ink list, with each value in the range 0 to 100.

property.name: parentColorGroup
property.shortdesc: The color group that a swatch belongs to

property.name: id
property.shortdesc: The unique ID of the Tint.

property.name: isValid
property.shortdesc: Returns true if the object specifier resolves to valid objects.

property.name: parent
property.shortdesc: The parent of the Tint (a Application or Document).

property.name: index
property.shortdesc: The index of the Tint within its containing object.

property.name: tintValue
property.shortdesc: The percent of the base color. (Range: 0 to 100)

property.name: label
property.shortdesc: A property that can be set to any string.

property.name: properties
property.shortdesc: A property that allows setting of several properties at the same time.

parameter.name: replacingWith
parameter.shortdesc: The swatch to apply in place of the deleted swatch. (Optional)

method.name: merge
method.shortdesc: Merges the specified swatches with the swatch.

parameter.name: with
parameter.shortdesc: The swatches to merge. Can accept: Array of Swatches, Swatch or String.

method.name: insertLabel
method.shortdesc: Sets the label to the value associated with the specified key.

method.name: extractLabel
method.shortdesc: Gets the label value associated with the specified key.

method.name: toSource
method.shortdesc: Generates a string which, if executed, will return the Tint.

method.name: getElements
method.shortdesc: Resolves the object specifier, creating an array of object references.

parameter.name: handler
parameter.shortdesc: The event handler. Can accept: File or JavaScript Function.

parameter.name: handler
parameter.shortdesc: The registered event handler. Can accept: File or JavaScript Function.
